title: Xinjiang Chuanr
subtitle: Coworker BBQ Trial
description: Uyghur charcoal lamb skewers for the coworker cookout: alternating lean and fat, cooked close over coals, with cumin and coarse chili rained onto the meat while the fat renders.
source: Coworker BBQ menu brainstorm; quantities TBD

items.note: hand-cut into thumbnail-size chunks; quantity TBD
cut to match the lean pieces and alternated on the skewers; quantity TBD

directions.title: Cut and skewer
directions.text: Hand-cut the lamb shoulder and pure fat into thumbnail-size chunks. Alternate lean pieces with fat pieces on flat metal skewers so the rendering fat bastes the lamb.

directions.title: Salt ahead
directions.text: Salt the skewered lamb before the cook. This is not a marinade; the cumin and chili come later over the fire.

directions.title: Build the fire
directions.text: Make a narrow, close charcoal bed with bricks flanking chimney-dumped coals. Bridge the skewers directly across the bricks with no grate and cook hot and fast.

directions.title: Dry rain
directions.text: As the fat renders, shower the skewers with toasted half-cracked cumin and coarse chili flake. Turn them over the coals so the spices toast in the lamb fat.

notes: Flat metal skewers are non-negotiable so the meat does not spin.
Optional supporting menu: smashed cucumber salad with black vinegar, store-bought naan hit hard on the grill, cold watermelon, and Yanjing or Tsingtao in an ice bucket.
